[[File:OpticalThermalImagingScope-FF73.png|thumb|right|250px|The Thermal/Optical-imaging scope on Zam Wesell's KiSteer 1284 rifle]]
A '''Thermal/Optical-imaging scope''' was a specialized [[Scope/Legends|targeting scope]] that displayed thermal imaging in addition to the standard [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] optics on typical scope. [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle/Legends|KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle]] was equipped with a Thermal/Optical-imaging scope<ref name="FF73">{{FactFile|73|WES 3-4|Zam Wesell's Weapons}}</ref> which that was configured to display targeting information<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in the same [[Unidentified script (Star Wars '76)|script]] as her [[Electro-goggles/Legends|electro-goggles]].<ref name="Holographic Artist">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/feature/20020716/indexp2.html|text=''Holographic'' Artist: Philip Metschan}}</ref>
